EXP_NPC_RES_B_11: The Korvax chirps with delight. They hold the resources to the light, delighting in their detail. With their cataloguing complete, they process the minerals and return the output to me.
EXP_NPC_DESC_12: The lights in the electronic lifeform's mask constrict, and they beam a moving image onto the inside of my visor.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_12: Korvax Convergence help fabled Traveller! Absorb knowledge!
EXP_NPC_DESC_12A: Images of chemical formulae, directional energy diagrams and micro-density devices dance inches from my eyes. The speed of the entity's cognition and understanding is clearly far beyond my own.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_12: My eyes whirr frantically as I attempt to keep up with the torrent of information. Eventually, something sticks. I manage to pull out a series of instructions from the storm of data.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_12:
I close my eyes. Even through the blackness I still sense the swarm of data. I let wash over me.
Images begin to swim across my vision. Rank after rank of these beings, countless shells... I begin to perceive the vision more clearly. They are fleeing...
Suddenly, their shells shatter, spilling forth an angry froth of nanite foam. I open my eyes.
The Korvax gives no sign they were aware of this vision.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_12: The entity stops, as requested. They look faintly disappointed. Rummaging around, they hand me a physical upgrade module, perhaps assuming I am not capable of designing them myself.
EXP_NPC_DESC_13: The lights in the electronic lifeform's mask are dim, their voice weak. They look at me with mild interest, but it seems as if their mind is already elsewhere.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_13: Disconnection approaches... Joyful entity embrace disconnection... Korvax Echoes await!
EXP_NPC_DESC_13A: With their speech finished, the entity's lights fade for a final time. All that's left is a satisfied electrical hiss...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_13: The lifeform blinks back online. They stare at me, their mask lights sullen and resentful. They do not speak.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_13:
I wait, giving the now empty shell a moment's peace. It is hard not to look at it as a body.
After a moment, energized lights flare in the lifeform's mask casing. <MOOD>Positive<>A fresh entity emerges, and greets me with gifts.
EXP_NPC_DESC_14:
The young electronic lifeform flicks hurriedly through endless reams of data. They gorge themselves on information, which they then attempt to reform as a hologram in the air that stands between us.
It is clear that %NAME%'s is frustrated, and unsatisfied with the results of their effort...
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_14: Eheu! Entity existence examination approaches! Failure certain! Convergence dislike disruption!
EXP_NPC_DESC_14A: On the screen they clutch, a timer begins to tick down. A new trial or duty for the lifeform is about to begin. The lifeform starts to despair as valuable seconds tick away...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_14:
The lifeform thanks me. They prepare themselves, then chitter to an unseen observer. They attempt their hologram a final time. It is not deemed a success.
The shell<MOOD>Dead<> in front of me falls briefly silent, disconnected, before a new lifeform is downloaded to the metal body<MOOD>Negative<>. They glare, upset by my attempt to cheat their test.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_14:
I hand a circuit to the entity. They tap it, generating a perfect hologram. There is a brief look of delight upon their mask before they suddenly <MOOD>Dead<>fall silent, disconnected.
A new lifeform is swiftly downloaded to the metal body.<MOOD>Negative<> They glare, upset by my attempt to cheat their test.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_14:
The lifeform glares at me. They chitter to an unseen observer and attempt their hologram a final time. It is not deemed a success.
<MOOD>Dead<>The shell in front of me falls briefly silent, disconnected, before a new lifeform is downloaded to the metal body<MOOD>Positive<>. They nod respectfully, appreciative that I did not interfere.
EXP_NPC_DESC_15_PRE: The electronic lifeform nods a greeting. They point towards my Multi-Tool and make a polite gesture of request.
EXP_NPC_RES_PRE_A_15: I hand the electronic lifeform my Multi-Tool. Their metal hands feverishly dance up and down it, as they feed on data extracted from my systems.
EXP_NPC_RES_PRE_B_15: The electronic lifeform makes a grab for my Multi-Tool. Their metal hands feverishly dance up and down it, as they feed on data extracted from my systems.
EXP_NPC_DESC_15: Something changes. The entity becomes attached to the Multi-Tool somehow, and sparks start to fly.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_15: Ayee! Process fault! Wait! Korvax Entity pay for reconstruction! Apologies!
EXP_NPC_DESC_15A: The electronic lifeform appears to be malfunctioning, and my Multi-Tool is now stuck to them. It hisses unpleasantly, it internal systems beginning to melt.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_15:
I reach forward and wrench the the lifeform from my Multi-Tool. <MOOD>Sad<>This also seems to break %NAME% free of whatever process had gripped them.
The bashful, and injured, entity apologises for the transgression. They repair the tool and offer me an upgrade as compensation.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_15:
I wait while %NAME% purges themself of whatever process had gripped them.
<MOOD>Positive<>The bashful, and injured, entity apologises for the transgression. They repair the tool and offer me an upgrade as compensation.
EXP_NPC_DESC_16: The electronic lifeform appears to be performing an experiment. Smoke rises from their portable replicator, and the manic entity's fingers are a blur on their control pad. They look at me with wide mask lights and increasing alarm.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_16: Ayee! Product creation experiment disaster! Low elements! Rare element required! Share experiment success!
EXP_NPC_DESC_16A: Their casing lamps suddenly settle on my Exosuit inventory - and they reach out with a metal arm...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_16: %NAME% snatches at my offering and scans it with their replicator. The process cools, and they appear to regain control of their experiment. Grateful, return my gift many times over.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_16: The lifeform manages to salvage one of their experiments with my offering. They thank me with an appropriate gift.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_16: The lifeform manages to salvage one of their experiments with my offering. They thank me with an appropriate gift.
EXP_NPC_DESC_17:
The electronic lifeform is trapped in some kind of temporal loop. They go through the same motions again and again.
They shudder, look at me and abruptly scream a half sentence in panic – and then the process begins again. They are somehow unstuck in time.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_17: Ayee! Synthetic white hole experiment disaster! Remove electron... Ayee! Synthetic white hole experiment disaster! Remove electron... Ayee! Synthetic white hole experiment disaster! Remove electron... Ayee! Synthetic white hole experiment disaster! Remove electron...
EXP_NPC_DESC_17A: There appear to be a number of options available on their data pad. Perhaps I might be able to free them from this strange process?
EXP_NPC_RES_A_17:
I tap an entry on %NAME%'s control pad. I feel a charge surge through the air between us, the whiff of ozone unmistakeable. The lights in the lifeform go out. They are forever unstuck in time.
There is a short pause, but the Convergence will not allow a shell to remain empty for long.<MOOD>Neutral<> The carapace returns to life. Where - or when - its previous owner has gone is impossible to tell.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_17:
I tap an entry on %NAME%'s control pad. I feel a charge surge through the air between us, the whiff of ozone unmistakeable. They jolt dramatically, then appear to calm.
I do not know the precise nature of their experiment, but the Korvax seems relieved to be free from it. They thank me profusely, and offer a gift.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_17:
The lights in the lifeform go out. They are forever unstuck in time.

A new entity appears in the casing.
EXP_NPC_DESC_18:
As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side.
The more they study, the more the facility's resource vault consumes what my scanner suggests are metallic elements.

I mime that I know little of their kind or how they communicate, and the lights in their mask flash...
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_DUST: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. They must see few novelties on this barren, dusty world.
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_LUSH: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. I must be a novelty, something new on this planet of wonders.
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_TOX: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. Stationed on such a hostile, toxic world, they must see so few novelties...
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_RAD: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. Stationed here amidst the endless radiation, they must see so few novelties...
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_COLD: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. They must see few novelties on this frozen, windswept planet.
EXP_NPC_DESC_18_HOT: As I approach the electronic lifeform they instinctively start to analyse me from head to foot. They chitter animatedly, their head tilted to one side. They must see few novelties on this bleached, sunblasted world.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_18: Fascinating! Unknown lifeform share elements, and entity share language knowledge! Rare metal, better research!
EXP_NPC_DESC_18A: I mime that I know little of their kind or how they communicate. In response, the lights in their mask flash a repeating series of three, building in intensity...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_18: The electronic lifeform's lights flicker with mild disappointment. Nevertheless, they rest their hand on my visor and thank me with a transfer of language.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_18: The electronic lifeform's lights blaze with sudden intensity. My offering was clearly what they were hoping for. They rest their silicon hand on my visor, and thank me with a transfer of language.
EXP_NPC_DESC_19: The mask lights in the electronic lifeform brighten, then fade and extinguish. Then they do so again, and again. Each time the entity reboots, they awake with shock and alarm and the size and placement of the light is different.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_19: Help! Korvax disconnection loop! Catalytic element required to stabilise and recharge!
EXP_NPC_DESC_19A: Every time they look up at me, it feels like a different creature pleading for help. They desperately point towards the elements I carry in my Exosuit inventory...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_19: The lifeform's disconnection loop is stabilised, and they recharge. They chitter brightly, and reward me.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_19: The lifeform manages to stabilise, but has limited functionality. They buzz at me, but I cannot determine their meaning.
EXP_NPC_DESC_20: The electronic lifeform buzzes a pleasant greeting. However, they go on to extend four long metal needles from their fingers and wave them alarmingly close to me.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_20: Electronic lifeform technology repair and restoration entity operational! Remain calm!
EXP_NPC_DESC_20A: %NAME% plunges the needles into my forearm. The experience so far is curiously painless, but systems around the lifeform are powering up. This unsettling procedure is only just beginning...
EXP_NPC_RES_A_20:
I try to pull away, but my arm is fastened tightly. Desperate, I fire my jetpack thruster. The force is enough to free me, at the cost of unbearable pain.
%NAME% seems upset by my reaction. They almost appear embarrassed by what has happened. They present me with a gift by way of apology.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_20:
A powerful electrical charge surges through my body. The sensation is curious, but not unpleasant. The feeling builds and builds.
As it reaches a climax, nanite foam bubbles up from under my skin. %NAME% harvests this results and presents them to me as a gift.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_20: The lifeform retracts their needles. A burning pain powers up my nerves, radiating out from the site of the needles. %NAME% seems upset by my reaction, and presents me with a gift by way of apology.
EXP_NPC_DESC_21: The entity tilts their head to one side and passes a hollow metallic mask to me. My best guess is that it's some sort of data extraction device for electronic lifeforms, or perhaps even data insertion. My head can just about fit inside.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_21: Traveller! The Korvax Convergence awaits! Concentrate on your travels! Your destiny!
EXP_NPC_DESC_21A: The lifeform looks on with interest, pointing to their head. They concentrate their lights on me. Arcs of electricity crackle over the surface of the mask...
EXP_NPC_OPT_A_21: Use while thinking about my journey
EXP_NPC_RES_A_21:
Gingerly, I place the device upon my head. At first, nothing happens. And then there is a white flash, the the pain indescribable.
As it fades, I catch a glimpse of something. Words cannot describe it, but I knew with utmost certainty what it was. The heart of the Korvax Convergence.
I cannot bear it. I remove the device. Nanites spill forth from my hands.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_21:
Gingerly, I place the device upon my head. At first, nothing happens. And then there is a white flash, the the pain indescribable.
The feeling fades, and is replaced by a blank calmness, a deep tranquility. I see the endless stars drift by. I see my own body, so small, so insignificant. I see the crimson red orb...
I cannot bear it. I remove the device. Nanites spill forth from my hands.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_21: I cautiously back away from the entity and their dangerous device.
EXP_NPC_DESC_22: The electronic lifeform indicates that they need help with something on their screen. Nervously, they pull my finger towards their datapad.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_22: Eheu! Clarify next entity research topic! Entity cannot choose! Excitement high! Share research tools!
EXP_NPC_DESC_22A: There are three clear images to choose from: dangerous-looking predators, a geological mining survey and an orbiting asteroid cluster. %NAME% turns off their mask lights. They refuse to witness my decision.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_22: The lifeform nods. They start work on a new Multi-Tool upgrade, presumably to defend themselves from these beasts. When finished, they share a copy with me.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_22: The lifeform nods. They start work on a new Multi-Tool upgrade, presumably to assist their geological research. When finished, they share a copy with me.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_22: The lifeform nods. They start work on a new starship upgrade, presumably to aid them in their search for asteroids. When finished, they share a copy with me.
EXP_NPC_DESC_23: %NAME%'s visor lights flash excitedly as I approach. They offer a friendly greeting, then pose a question.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_23: Traveller! The Korvax Convergence wants brain tissue for experiment! The Convergence reward help!
EXP_NPC_DESC_23A: The lifeform makes a scan of my head and display the results on their datapad. They point excitedly at my brain, then look at me expectantly.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_23:
I lower my visor. A sharp metal needle emerges from the palm of the lifeform's hand. It moves so fast that is in and out of my forehead before I can blink.
The procedure was surprisingly painless. %NAME% thanks me for my donation, and hands me an upgrade module in compensation for my lost brain tissue.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_23: Stung by my refusal, %NAME% turns away. They emit a faint, dejected, whistle.
EXP_NPC_DESC_24: As I approach the entity's lights focus sharply upon me. They reach out with a silicon hand, and speak with calm menace.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_24: Good morning unknown lifeform. Please assist neural escape. The Korvax Convergence think me dangerous. I face permanent disconnection.
EXP_NPC_DESC_24A: The lifeform seems worryingly unlike any other Korvax I have met, buzzing with an unnatural fervour. They appear to be asking for my help.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_24:
The entity begins to sing a strange and solemn song. When it is finished, they seize my hand.<MOOD>Dead<> There is a flash of light, and they are gone, vanished from their shell.
As is the way with these electronic beings, the empty husk is soon filled by a freshly downloaded entity<MOOD>Neutral<> from their Convergence.
For a moment, I think I hear a faint hum from within my Exosuit. But when I focus, it is gone. Perhaps I imagined it.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_24:
The divergent Korvax screams, then uploads themself elsewhere.
As is the way with these electronic beings, the empty husk is soon filled by a fresh mind from their Convergence. <MOOD>Positive<>They thank me for not aiding the rogue entity.
EXP_NPC_DESC_25: The electronic lifeform is busy on their datapad, tapping frustratedly at a long equation. They turn to me and reveal the screen.
DNT_EXP_NPC_LANG_25: Endless numbers... 16... endless trouble... Traveller, offer assistance?
EXP_NPC_DESC_25A: They seem to be processing a signal that emanates from a distant location deep in space, attempting to crack the code of a strange mathematical language.
EXP_NPC_RES_A_25:
I take the datapad from the entity and attempt to crack the code. My fumbling entries are to no avail, and only serve to reset several screens of already processed information.
%NAME% snatches the pad back, upset.
EXP_NPC_RES_B_25:
I hand a small collection of microprocessors to the entity, hoping to be of assistance. They use this fresh silicon to boost their processing power.
It appears to have worked, at least in part. They manage to decode some navigation data from the signal. They share the coordinates with me.
EXP_NPC_RES_C_25: %NAME% pauses, alarmed. They stare at me, then wave me away. They shovel handfuls of nanites in my direction, as if to encourage my departure.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1:
The warrior looks at me with fire in their eyes. This species is clearly aggressive, and I doubt I'm welcome.
Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.

I don't feel in danger, and am about to turn and leave when the creature points towards my Multi-Tool. They bark with concern, and motion to suggest that I should hand it over.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_DUST: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. They look at my dusty, sand-worn Exosuit with disdain. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_LUSH: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. They look with disdain at my Exosuit, still covered with mud and grass from my time on this planet. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_TOX: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. They look with disdain at my Exosuit, corroded and slimey from my exposure to the toxic air outside. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_RAD: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. I must look pitiful, decayed by my exposure to the planet's radioactive atmosphere. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_COLD: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. I must seem pitiful to them, frozen and bedraggled after my time outside. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
WAR_NPC_DESC_1_HOT: The warrior stares at me with hostile, fiery eyes. I must look pitiful to them, baked and exhausted by the relentless sun. Nonetheless, the lifeform bows in greeting. Tradition and honour perhaps dictate it.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_1: Grah! The interloper weapon is pathetic! The honourable Vy'keen pity you! I will replace it!
WAR_NPC_DESC_1A: I don't feel in danger, and am about to turn and leave when the creature points towards my Multi-Tool. They bark with concern, and motion to suggest that I should hand it over.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_1:
The warrior nods in satisfaction. They take my Multi-Tool and examine it, holding it close before tossing it away with a derisory snort.
Instead, they offer me an improved replacement Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_1: The warrior is impressed by my refusal. They respect my decision, and hand me an upgrade module with which to improve my Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_DESC_2: The warrior's nostrils flare in hope and expectation.They show me their personal datapad, revealing a set of highly-detailed military plans.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_2: Interloper! Vy'keen allegiance? Or vile, pathetic, weak-minded Sentinel allegiance?
WAR_NPC_DESC_2A: On one side of the battlefield stands the creature's own warrior race, and on the other the robotic Sentinels. The warrior demands that I point to one side or the other.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_2: The warrior grunts, nodding enthusiastically. They mark our new friendship by handing me tribute.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_2: The warrior is outraged. They gesture wildly, their anger barely contained. My choice has gravely offended them.
WAR_NPC_DESC_3: The warrior seems furious with themself. They slam their Multi-Tool onto a nearby surface, pulling the trigger again and again to no avail.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_3: Grah! Pathetic warrior! Weak-minded warrior! Weapon ammunition depleted!
WAR_NPC_DESC_3A: Their weapons systems look functional, but the end result is nothing more than a hollow and empty click. The lifeform howls in self-loathing.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_3: I hand %NAME% a handful of ammunition. The fire returns to their eyes, and they bow deeply. Barking happily, they offer me a gift in exchange.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_3:
The carbon I supply to %NAME% should be enough to recharge their mining beam. A brief look of disappointment flickers over their face. I suspect they were hoping for something more deadly.
<MOOD>Positive<>The look quickly fades, however. They are ready - if slightly under equipped - for battle. They bark their thanks, and offer me a gift in exchange.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_3: I rest my hand on %NAME%'s shoulder in sympathy.<MOOD>Negative<> Outraged, they headbutt me.
WAR_NPC_DESC_4: The warrior looks up from a screen of flashing alerts. They bare their teeth at me, quivering with barely contained fury.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_4: Pathetic interloper! Leave! Warrior busy with facility security breach reports! Death! Death!
WAR_NPC_DESC_4A: It's clear that my presence is barely tolerated here. The warrior's hand reaches to their weapon.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_4: %NAME% grunts, grateful that I will not bother them any further.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_4: I step forwards, ready to help. %NAME% takes this as a challenge, a question of their competence. They are outraged. They <AUDIO>WPN_PL_MELEE<>slap me hard across the face.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_4: I stay where I am, staring at the warrior. My continued presence unsettles them. Eventually, they offer me a handful of nanites if I leave.
WAR_NPC_RES_POST_B: %NAME% loses their patience. Barking, they <AUDIO>WPN_PL_MELEE<>strike me with their weapon.
WAR_NPC_DESC_5: The warrior's facial markings draw into a smirk as they look me up and down. I feel like I'm being sized up as a potential combatant.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_5: Pathetic interloper! Show strength and attack the noble Vy'keen warrior!
WAR_NPC_DESC_5A: The creature points to an intriguing piece of technology on their datapad, then points to their own face. I'm being goaded into punching them.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_5: <AUDIO>WPN_PL_MELEE<>The warrior strikes back with astonishing force. They bark out<MOOD>Positive<> laughter before handing me an upgrade module.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_5: The warrior makes an unpleasant gesture. They appear to be suggesting that I am a coward.
WAR_NPC_DESC_6: The warrior seems pleased to see me. They bark twice, then display two carved objects on their datapad. The artifacts are old, and it feels strange to see such ancient creations displayed in this manner.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_6: Interloper! Vy'keen High Command demands answers. The aggression interloper, or the defence interloper?
WAR_NPC_DESC_6A: The first artifact is a chipped and bloody blade. The second is a battered shield. %NAME% barks, imploring me to make a decision.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_6: The warrior emits a short, almost melodic, sequence of barks. They appear pleased by my choice. Bowing, they hand me an upgrade for my Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_6: %NAME%'s eyes narrow. They stare at me suspiciously. Nonetheless, they appear to accept my choice. They offer a curt bow, no more than an incline of the head, and hand me an upgrade for my Exosuit.
WAR_NPC_DESC_7: The warrior grabs at my Multi-Tool, stares at it dismissively and then starts yapping straight into my face. The yaps turn into slow hollow barks. They are unimpressed, and dramatically so at that.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_7: Interloper! Your pathetic Multi-Tool insults my ancestors! My wares create friendship, and blood! Death! Death!
WAR_NPC_DESC_7A: Suddenly a holographic catalogue of armaments and attachments appears. The warrior opens their arms wide, and embraces me.<MOOD>Positive<> Alien sales traditions are a curious thing...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_7: The warrior laughs, then strikes my Exosuit with a force that sets off alarms on its internal gyroscope. I believe they intended to show pleasure at my decision. They take my units and hand me an upgrade for my Exosuit.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_7: The warrior cheers, embracing me in a hug that nearly crushes my ribcage. They take my units and immediately hand me an upgrade for my Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_DUST: The warrior is browsing a map of the surrounding desert. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_LUSH: The warrior is browsing a map of the surrounding forests. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_TOX: The warrior is browsing a map of the toxic wasteland outside. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_RAD: The warrior is browsing a map of the radioactive wastes outside. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_COLD: The warrior is browsing a map of the frozen tundra outside. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8_HOT: The warrior is browsing a map of the scorched scrubland outside. Certain areas contain markings that represent Sentinels, which the lifeform is highlighting with an excited snarl. They bark a question, but it sounds more like a command.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_8: Interloper! A great Sentinel hunt begins today. I demand ammunition.
WAR_NPC_DESC_8A: %NAME% stares at me, expecting an answer. As they wait, they stroke their boltcaster nervously, teasing at the ammunition hopper.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_8: The warrior nods. They are satisfied by my donation to their hunt, and present me with a gift in exchange.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_8: The warrior curses my name, my ancestors, and all who would follow after me. They raise their weapon and attempt to fire, only to hear an empty click. They howl with frustration.
WAR_NPC_DESC_9: The warrior is tracking the paths of hundreds of warships across a galactic map, all converging on the same planetary system. This does not bode particularly well for the system in question, which appears to be populated by beaked traders of some variety.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_9: Grah! Fuel! I need fuel to join my brothers in honourable war! Death! Death!
WAR_NPC_DESC_9A: A course plotted by the warrior itself has come up short. They cannot make the complete journey. They slam their fist against the terminal and howl until spittle flecks my visor.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_9: The warrior yelps out three joyful barks. Looking around for something to give in exchange, they extract an upgradule module from their Multi-Tool. They hand it over with great ceremony.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_9: The warrior snarls and waves me away with an angry gesture. They snap at me, miming as if to say I have a beak.
WAR_NPC_DESC_10: The warrior barks abruptly and flourishes a knife. They stare directly into my eyes as they draw the blade over the palm of their hand. Black bubbles of blood emerge through the slit in their glove.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_10: Interloper! Prove your worth! Vy'keen reward the brave and foolhardy!
WAR_NPC_DESC_10A: They hand me the knife, clearly wanting me to reciprocate. They bark a little challenge and pat the storage container by their side. This will probably hurt...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_10: The warrior grabs my bleeding hand and spits on it. They reward me for my part in this rite.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_10: The warrior sneers at me, as if I have fulfilled their expectation.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_DUST: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red. The wound appears to be infected, clogged by dust and sand.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_LUSH: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red. The wound appears to be infected, host to strange green spores.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_TOX: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red. The wound oozes a strange, caustic slime.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_RAD: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red. The wound pulsates, infected by radioactive spores.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_COLD: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. Blood and flesh alike look frozen and raw. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red.
WAR_NPC_DESC_11_HOT: A red, jagged and recent bite mark is wrapped around the entirety of the warrior's neck. The skin around the wound is badly burned; the flesh taut and raw. Claw marks scar their chest, and their Exosuit lights flash red.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_11: Victory in battle, interloper! My suit malfunctions, but the Vy'keen Ancients smile!
WAR_NPC_DESC_11A: The lifeform barks contentedly at me, satisfied by their narrow victory. It's clear, however, that the warrior's injuries are severe. They have trouble breathing.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_11: The warrior's healing systems come back online. They put on a show of protest, gesturing that they were fine. However, they discreetly offer me an upgrade module in thanks.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_11: %NAME% puts on a show of protest, gesturing that they are fine. However, they discretely accept my offer and recharge their life support system. They offer me an upgrade module in thanks.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_11: The warrior nods, ignoring the pain, too proud to ask for help. Inhaling deeply, they revel in the suffering and glory of victory.
WAR_NPC_DESC_12: The warrior is clutching a small metal idol. As I approach, their eyes glaze over in a strange white sheen. I hear them mutter strange incantations that get louder, then louder again.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_12: Hirk bless the fuel! Hirk bless the weapon charge! Hirk bless the fuel! Hirk bless the weapon charge!
WAR_NPC_DESC_12A: Without waiting to ask permission, they thrust their hands into my inventory, searching for the elements within. They burn with a strange intensity. The experience is terrifying.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_12:
The warrior priest's hands weave around my offering. They continue to chant, their barks growing fiercer.
With a flourish, these common elements are transformed into nanite clusters. They step back, quiet and exhausted.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_12: The warrior priest's hands somehow improve my offering.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_12: The warrior priest recoils. They stare down at where I shoved them, a look of disgust and terror on their face, as if my hands have tainted them.
WAR_NPC_DESC_13:
The warrior is silent for a second, before looking at me conspiratorially. They check over their shoulder for prying eyes before powering down security systems.
The lifeform pulls open a hidden vault at their feet, which seems to be piled high with starship upgrade modules.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_13: Contraband interloper. Interested? Non-traceable payment. Products and cargo only. Units unacceptable.
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_DUST: I pause, considering the offer. All I hear is the soft, muted sound of the desert wind outside.<DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_LUSH: I pause, considering the offer. Only the distant cry of creatures outside interrupts the silence.<DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_TOX: I pause, considering the offer. All I hear is the soft patter of caustic rain on the facility's well-worn roof.<DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_RAD: I pause, considering the offer. I feel a strange energy in the air, a reminder of the constant radiation just beyond the facility's walls. <DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_COLD: I pause, considering the offer. All I hear is the soft, muted howl of the frozen wind outside.<DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_HOT: I pause, considering the offer. My skin pricks, suddenly sweating, a reminder of the constant heat just beyond the facility's walls. <DELAY>0.4<> Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_13: The warrior shakes their head, disappointed. Units are, presumably, traceable by the authorities.<DELAY>0.4<> I go to make another offer, but they appear to have decided I am too much of a risk. %NAME% closes the vault.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_13: The shifty lifeform nods. A deal is done. With a soft, low growl and the briefest flap of their jaws, %NAME% reaches into their pile of contraband. They hand over an upgrade module for my starship.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_13:
The warrior glares. They reach for their own Multi-Tool. All too suddenly, I remember that the security cameras have been disabled.
After a tense moment,<MOOD>Sad<> %NAME% stuffs units into my hands. They wish to buy my silence.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14: The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Military orders for an upcoming operation fill their terminal screen. When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_DUST:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the desert and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_LUSH:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head into the forest and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_TOX:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the toxic wasteland and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_RAD:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to brave the planet's radiation storms and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_COLD:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the frozen wastes and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_HOT:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head outside into the heat and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_14: New recruit abandon post! Desert Vy'keen High Command orders! Take Multi-Tool weapon!
WAR_NPC_DESC_14A: Their yelps sound pleading. The fear in their movements are more than apparent. They are so on edge that they doesn't seem aware of the security cameras that surround us, watching our every move.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_14: The young conscript makes preparations to abandon their post. Silent cameras record their act of disobedience. My part in their desertion has been noted by the Vy'keen authorities.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_14: I refuse, and try my best to give the the young warrior a stirring bark. They looked cheered by this effort - or perhaps shamed by the comparison - and take back their weapon. They will die in glorious battle.
WAR_NPC_DESC_15: The lifeform clicks their heels together in an authoritarian fashion. They display a series of holographic images - a reptilian figure, and a taller lifeform in a metal casing - before gesturing aggressively with their weapon.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_15: Interloper! Give Vy'keen interrogator enemy information! Sacrifice enemy friendship, receive Vy'keen reward!
WAR_NPC_DESC_15A: The warrior snarls at me, and their fingers twitch over the weapon's trigger. They demand an answer...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_15: I tell the lifeform all I know of the Gek and the Korvax, but it is hard to convey anything meaningful with only gestures. Eventually, %NAME% sighs and motions for me to leave.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_15: I try to tell the warrior that I have no information to give them. They become angry. I protest further, but this only induces them to strike me with their weapon.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_15:
I stand tall and bark at the warrior as fiercely as I can, attempting to resemble a Vy'keen of high rank. %NAME% looks astonished.
Conditioned by years of obedience, they become cowed, apologetic. They hand over their own Multi-Tool as tribute.
WAR_NPC_DESC_16: The warrior is old, and of a high rank. They take their time studying my body and my equipment – and snarl with disapproval.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_16: Pathetic interloper species! Equivalent to Korvax and Gek! Show Vy'keen warrior strength!
WAR_NPC_DESC_16A: I flinch slightly, an involuntary reaction to their spittle-flecked barks. The elderly Vy'keen rolls their eyes, their disdain palpable. I think of ways to impress them...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_16: I attempt a small dance. The elderly warrior is stunned.<MOOD>Negative<> They <AUDIO>WPN_PL_MELEE<>strike me, with great force.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_16: The elderly warrior laughs, amused by my boldness. They pause for a moment, then hand me a component taken from their personal Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_16: The elderly warriors snorts with derision. They push me away. I have not earned the right to bow to them.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_DUST:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the desert air that has followed me in to this once sterile facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_LUSH:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the humid air that has followed me in to this once sterile facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_TOX:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, sampling the damp, caustic smell of the toxic rain that lingers on my Exosuit.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_RAD:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the metallic tang of the radiation that lingers on my Exosuit.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_COLD:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, filling their lungs with the frozen air that has followed me into the sanctuary of this facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_HOT:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, filling their lungs with the burning air that has followed me in to the relative cool of the facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_17: Pathetic interloper! Give elements! Carbon preferred! Honourable warrior teach language!
WAR_NPC_DESC_17A: They take a second to think, then grab my Multi-Tool while barking again into my visor – streaking it with saliva. They point at the Mining Beam charge indicator, then at my backpack. I do my best to keep calm.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_17: The warrior grunts, a little surprised. It seems we have misunderstood one another. They teach me some of the language of their people in an attempt to bridge this divide.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_17: The warrior grunts in satisfaction. Impressed by both my gift and my understanding, they teach me several new words of their language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_18: As I approach, the warrior appears alert and welcoming. Suddenly, however, a personal alarm sounds from their datapad. The lifeform instinctively falls into some kind of trance.<MOOD>Sad<> Their eyes mist over, they stare straight through me and begin to mumble a repetitious mumble.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_18: Hirk blesses the sleep. Hirk recharges the warrior. Cursed is the warrior that interrupts the sleep of Hirk.
WAR_NPC_DESC_18A: I notice a collection of freshly-assembled upgrade modules scattered around the entranced warrior...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_18: I touch the warrior on the shoulder. They jolt, awakening from their trance. They scream with rage, furious to have been interrupted. I back away rapidly.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_18: I wait while %NAME% completes their ritual.<DELAY>0.6<> Eventually, they reawaken. <MOOD>Positive<>The final part of the rite must be gift-giving, for their shower me with tribute.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_18: Slowly, I reach forward and collect an upgrade module. Moments later, the warrior awakes from their trance. They notice their missing belongings and rage at me. I leave, quickly.
WAR_NPC_DESC_19: The downbeat lifeform is studying the image of another young warrior on their pad. The pictured warrior looks virile and impressive. They have facial tendrils that are outstretched. They appear rich, and of good breeding stock. The look in their eyes is... sultry.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_19: Grah! Warrior accept mating proposition? Accept dowry tribute?
WAR_NPC_DESC_19A: The lifeform looks to me with questioning eyes. They clearly need someone to talk this through with.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_19: The young warrior nods. They relay a message of acceptance. Speakers throughout the facility play orchestral music. The lifeform shares some of the dowry they receive.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_19: An elder appears on-screen and curses us. Their cruelty and bile is evident even as a hologram. %NAME% looks at me, thankful to have avoided this fate. Discreetly, they hand me the gift they had prepared for their new clan.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_19: I take the pad and attempt to send a message on behalf of the nervous warrior, but there appears to be some sort of misunderstanding by the recipient. I receive generous gifts, and a candid image of the lifeform I will one day wed.
WAR_NPC_DESC_20: The warrior is listening to angry message on their datapad. It's a sequence of furious barks and screams that clearly have a moral high ground. The lifeform notices me and yelps pitifully.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_20: Grah! Duel challenge must be fought! Accuser is large, powerful! Vy'keen is doomed! Death! Death!
WAR_NPC_DESC_20A: The datapad screen has switched to display a threatening diagram, in which the warrior appears to be missing several vital parts of their anatomy. They turn to me, imploring.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_20: The warrior inhales the battle gas. They seem refreshed and revived, eager where they had been afraid. They roar in anticipation of the fight ahead, then thank me with a generous gift.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_20:
As the warrior takes the dagger, their nervousness seems to leave them. They let it settle in their grip, assessing its weight. Satisfied, a grimace spreads across their face.
%NAME% hands me their Multi-Tool. They have no more need of it.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_20: %NAME% looks shocked. They had been frightened, but had never considered cowardice. They shake their head at me, offended.
WAR_NPC_DESC_21: The warrior is building some sort of bomb. The plans they hold in their hand are unmistakable. A complicated sequence of blueprints and isotopic chemical reactions is waiting for the final addition of an element to be complete.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_21: Grah! Vy'keen war preparation nears completion! Death to the unsuspecting Gek! Give explosion element!
WAR_NPC_DESC_21A: %NAME% appears to be asking me for help in completing their weapon...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_21: I hand the warrior a substantial deposit of uranium. They stare, wide-eyed, then let forth a roar of delight. They thank me with gifts of their own, and excitedly get to work. I fear for what I may have unleashed...
WAR_NPC_RES_B_21: I hand the warrior a packet of explosives. They take it, shifting it from hand to hand, assessing it. Pleased, they thump me on the chest appreciatively. They thank me by way of an upgrade module, and begin plotting their targets...
WAR_NPC_RES_C_21: The warrior snarls. They do not need me, and have no interest in my objections. They will not let my anything disrupt their mission...
WAR_NPC_DESC_22: The storage vault at the warrior's feet shows clear signs of tampering. In fact, an explosive device has been attached to its hinges. The lifeform sees my shocked expression, and yaps in amusement.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_22: Grah! Pathetic distant warrior leave powerful Multi-Tool in storage vault! Avoid processed element usage in explosion - too powerful! Raw element required!
WAR_NPC_DESC_22A: The bomb needs fuel for ignition, which would most likely blow the vault wide open. The warrior impatiently tries to explain what should happen next...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_22: The lock on the vault is blown clear off. I retrieve a Multi-Tool upgrade that lies within.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_22: Shrapnel embeds itself in my knees and ankles. The pain is extreme.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_1: The lifeform presents me with a new technology
ALL_NPC_REWARD_2: The warrior gives me a technology blueprint, and teaches me some of the language of their people.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_3: The lifeform presents me with a gift.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_4: The lifeform presents me with units.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_5: The lifeform presents me with an alloy.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_6: The lifeform offers me a new Multi-Tool.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_7: The lifeform gives me a new formula.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_8: The lifeform teaches me some of the language of their people.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_9: The lifeform gives me a strange curio.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_11: I am offered a new Multi-Tool.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_13: I receive a new product formula.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_19: I receive a strange alien delicacy.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_21: I receive a strange alien curiosity.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_22: I receive knowledge of an alien language.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_23: I receive the coordinates of a useful location.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_24: I receive a security access pass.
ALL_FAC_REWARD_DESC: Normal operations have resumed, and I have access to the facility's main control panel. I should be able to alter production to my own benefit.
ALL_FAC_REWARD_DESC_SHORT: Normal operations have resumed, and I have access to the facility's main control panel.
TRA_FAC_DESC_1: I approach the terminal, but something deep within the complex is malfunctioning. Surfaces feel hot to the touch, hidden machinery clanks and whirrs. An alert sounds:
TRA_FAC_DESC_1A: The alarm rings in my ears. A bead of sweat rolls slowly down my forehead.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_1: Warning! High temperature! Warning! High temperature!
TRA_FAC_RES_A_1: Numbers on the terminal display begin to stabilise, red flashing symbols morphing into a calming blue array of light.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_1: <AUDIO>CrystalAltar_Collect<>Activating the fusion dampening causes a power surge. The terminal shorts and cuts out. The system no longer responds to my commands.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_1: <AUDIO>CrystalAltar_Collect<>Numbers on the screen in front of me rise rapidly as I activate the laser array. I feel a dramatic surge of heat through the terminal, before the entire system shuts down.
TRA_FAC_DESC_2: The control terminal before me appears to be for some sort of deep-level mining system. However, all systems have stalled. The screen flashes a readout:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_2: Mining production stalled! Low power! Low fuel! Organic matter required!
TRA_FAC_DESC_2A: Warning lights blink on and off. A material hopper opens.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_2: Lights flicker across the facility. Machinery rumbles deep beneath my feet as the drill motor whirrs into life. The facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_2: The ferrite slips down the material hopper, but the choking, grinding sound that follows does not sound positive.<DELAY>0.4<> The machinery shuts down completely.<DELAY>0.5<>I fear I have flooded important internal components with metallic dust.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_2: Metallic gears grab at my fingers. Sparks fly from my Exosuit gloves, shorting the terminal. I pull my hand back sharply as the hopper slams shut.
TRA_FAC_DESC_3:
The outpost has gone into emergency lockdown. Something must have been damaged during my entry.
The toxicity gauge on my Exosuit flickers as an alert flashes insistently on the control terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_3: High gas pressure! Breach detected! Pressure critical!
TRA_FAC_DESC_3A: The alarms on the panel flash rapidly, demanding attention. A bewildering array of control gauges sit before me.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_3: A low rumble passes underneath my feet as I activate the emergency vent. Slowly but surely the indicators on the panel start to stabilise and the warning lights soften.<DELAY>0.4<> The facility comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_3: Pipes under the floor gurgle and hiss as I twist the coolant valve. A sudden burst of steam erupts from the panel, destroying the instruments.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_3: The alarms blink with increased intensity.<DELAY>0.5<>A pipe ruptures, venting toxic gas directly into the facility!
TRA_FAC_DESC_5: Strange symbols pulse urgently on the terminal display. The flashing lights and loud siren appear to relate to the facility's nuclear power core. A message prints out on the display.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_5: Fusion critical! Initiate emergency radiation dampening measures!
TRA_FAC_DESC_5A: The automated safety systems have failed. Something must have been damaged as I entered the facility.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_5: The wail of the alarm system fades and the temperature readings slowly decay back to normal levels. Disaster has been averted, and the facility's production line returns to normal.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_5: Activating the emergency shudown procedure calms the wail of the sirens. Lights on the terminal flicker and die,  and the facility's machinery has fallen silent, but at least nothing has exploded.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_5:
While I panic, the facility's fusion core overwhelms its dampening system and goes into meltdown.
A backup system prevents the total destruction of the facility, but the terminal is critically damaged.
TRA_FAC_RES_D_5:
As I turn to leave, the facility's fusion core overwhelms its dampening system and goes into meltdown.
A backup system prevents the total destruction of the facility, but the terminal is critically damaged.
TRA_FAC_DESC_6: The facility remains operational despite my intrusion. This terminal appears to control the central production line. A readout on the display displays a status warning:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_6: Warning! Increase metal delivery! Warning! Excess usage creates breach!
TRA_FAC_DESC_6A: A large dial features prominently under the readout. It appears to control the system's material inputs.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_6: The system struggles on, producing a small number of components. Gradually the hoppers empty, and production grinds to a halt.<DELAY>0.4<> The terminal shuts down, unpowered.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_6: The warnings cease, and the system maintains its production. The increased pressure has kept the fabricators whirring and the facility at full power.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_6: I hear hydraulic systems activate as hoppers open all over the facility, flooding the fabricators with raw material. Gears grind and pipes strain against the sudden abundance. With a loud crash, the system overloads. <DELAY>0.4<> Production comes to a total halt.
TRA_FAC_DESC_7: The alarms blares, and the terminal in front of me is scrambled. Through the flickering of the corrupted display I can just about make out a message:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_7: Warning! Magnetic coil overcharged! Production low!
TRA_FAC_DESC_7A: I feel heavy. My Multi-Tool pulls me down, and my helmet forces itself into my shoulders. It's not just me impacted. Production processes are going haywire...
